title: Changed Circumstances and Revised Loan Estimates on the Mortgage Loan File
content:
**Valid changed circumstances.** Charges disclosed on the Loan Estimate of a Mortgage Loan File may be re-baselined only for a valid changed circumstance: a borrower-requested change, a rate lock after a floating Loan Estimate, a lock extension or relock the borrower requested, an appraised value different from the value on the application, a loan amount change, a program change, a third-party charge increase caused by new information specific to the borrower or property, or a settlement delayed more than 60 days past the date shown on the Loan Estimate for a new-construction purchase. A lock extension caused by a Larkspur delay, a pricing error or a fee Larkspur simply forgot is never a changed circumstance.

**When a revised Loan Estimate may be issued.** A revised Loan Estimate may be issued only while no Closing Disclosure has been issued on the file and the loan file status is processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended or clear to close.

**Redisclosure window.** A revised Loan Estimate is valid only if it is issued no later than the end of the redisclosure window that starts on the date the changed circumstance was documented. Business days are counted forward from the documented date of the changed circumstance, which is day zero; issuing on the last business day of the window is timely. The window is the program's redisclosure period in business days. A business day is Monday through Friday excluding the US federal public holidays observed by the Federal Reserve Banks; Saturdays, Sundays and those holidays are skipped when counting.

**Receipt before consummation.** The revised Loan Estimate must also be received by the borrower no later than the program's number of specific business days before consummation set for revised Loan Estimates, where a specific business day is every calendar day except Sundays and the US federal public holidays; when it cannot be, the change is disclosed on the Closing Disclosure instead.

**Baseline effect.** The clause "A timely revised Loan Estimate becomes the good-faith baseline for the charges the circumstance actually affected; an untimely one, or one issued without a valid reason, leaves the earlier Loan Estimate as the baseline" is no longer in force for the zero-tolerance cure assessed before consummation, and only for it. For every other comparison, including the 10 percent bucket and the final Closing Disclosure after consummation, a timely revised Loan Estimate still becomes the good-faith baseline for the charges the circumstance actually affected, and an untimely one, or one issued without a valid reason, still leaves the earlier Loan Estimate as the baseline.

**Term and program updates.** Updating loan terms or the program on the file records the new facts and does not by itself re-baseline any charge.

## Decision table

| Situation | Valid changed circumstance |
|---|---|
| Borrower asks to change the loan | yes |
| Rate locked after a floating Loan Estimate | yes |
| Lock extension or relock the borrower requested | yes |
| Lock extension caused by a Larkspur delay | no |
| Pricing error, or a fee Larkspur forgot | no |
| Appraised value differs from the application value | yes |
| Loan amount change; program change | yes |
| Third-party charge rises on new information specific to the borrower or property | yes |
| New-construction purchase settlement delayed more than 60 days past the Loan Estimate date | yes |

## Redisclosure window, worked through (hypothetical, 3-business-day window, no holidays)

A changed circumstance documented on a Tuesday may be redisclosed on a revised Loan Estimate issued as late as Friday (Wednesday 1, Thursday 2, Friday 3); a revised Loan Estimate issued the following Monday is outside the window. The evidence is the documented date recorded with the changed circumstance and the file's status and disclosure history.

superseded_clauses: A timely revised Loan Estimate becomes the good-faith baseline for the charges the circumstance actually affected; an untimely one, or one issued without a valid reason, leaves the earlier Loan Estimate as the baseline.
